title: QUIZ - 77
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Compare the steepness of two lines using the absolute value of their slopes
questions.question: Line A has a slope of -6, and Line B has a slope of -3. Which line is steeper?

options.label: A
options.text: Line A

options.label: B
options.text: Steepness cannot be compared using slope

options.label: C
options.text: Line B

options.label: D
options.text: Both lines are equally steep

questions.explanation: Steepness is measured by the absolute value of the slope: |-6| = 6 and |-3| = 3. The line with the greater absolute slope, Line A, is steeper.
questions.hint: Compare the absolute values of the two slopes; a larger absolute value means a steeper line.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the slope of a line from its slope-intercept equation
questions.question: What is the slope of the line \( y = 6x - 2 \)?
questions.explanation: In the slope-intercept form y = mx + b, the coefficient of x is the slope. Here, the slope is 6.
questions.hint: In y = mx + b form, the slope is the coefficient of x.

questions.concept: Interpreting Slope as Rate of Change
questions.learningObjective: Interpret the real-world meaning of a slope in a linear model
questions.question: In a linear model of a plant's height over weeks, the slope is 10. What does this slope represent?

options.label: A
options.text: The starting value is 10 cm.

options.label: B
options.text: The total a plant's height over weeks is 10 cm.

options.label: C
options.text: The growth rate is 10 weeks per cm.

options.label: D
options.text: The growth rate is 10 cm per week.

questions.explanation: The slope represents the rate of change: for every additional week, the quantity changes by 10 cm.
questions.hint: The slope of a linear model represents its constant rate of change.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the slope of a line from its slope-intercept equation
questions.question: What is the slope of the line \( y = 2t - 15 \)?
questions.explanation: In the slope-intercept form y = mt + b, the coefficient of t is the slope. Here, the slope is 2.
questions.hint: In y = mx + b form, the slope is the coefficient of x.
